name: uptime
description: The uptime monitor's domain: monitors, checks, incidents and groups, kept as JSON in the app's data home; every check runs through a Checker port, so tests need no network.
mount: a row `- id: uptime` / `name: uptime` before the page rows in blend.yaml; a page injects the `uptime` service

config.file: the JSON file, relative to the app's home (default uptime.json)
config.clock: what time it is, for tests
config.newId: how ids are made, for tests
config.checker: a Checker port; the server builds the real HTTP/TCP one, tests pass a fake
